originality.rationale: Full eligible September 2026 primary source establishes only a sufficient universal convergence threshold, the full earlier 1998 source likewise studies sufficient bounds, and the fully inspected October 2026 rigidity theorem applies only to real-analytic drives. Our compactly supported noncommuting C-infinity resonant finite-stopping family lies outside all three implication domains. Published-literature searches found no direct coverage. Priority is best knowledge, with risk of uncatalogued prior constructions.
residual_risks: An unindexed Lie-group or quantum-control construction might already contain C-infinity Fer two-factor resonances.

value.rationale: Provides a natural, nontrivial exact-termination class for the widely used unitary Fer propagation method, at countably many explicit resonant amplitudes and arbitrary angular winding. It identifies a genuine smooth-versus-analytic boundary and shows arbitrarily large pulse area does not preclude exact two-factor stopping in specially engineered quantum controls, independently of numerical approximations. The finding is more than a root computation or an isolated approximate example.
